# CheckGrow

> AI-powered talent matching and team formation platform. Build your swarm — connect professionals, organizations, and projects through intelligent skill matching, integrated CRM, and collaborative project management.

CheckGrow ("CheckGrow") is an OS for distributed teams and agencies. It uses AI to match supply (talent) with demand (projects), manages the full lifecycle from lead to delivery, and provides shared CRM, calendars, and project workspaces across organizations ("organizations").

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, value proposition, and entry point.
- [Demo](/demo): Interactive product walkthrough — demand agent, supply agent, and CRM.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Authentication entry for talent and organizations.
- [Join an Organization](/join-kolektiv): Discover and request membership in organizations.
- [Pitch](/pitch): Investor pitch deck and CheckGrow engine overview.
